testcase.name: Scenario: Update unavailable physical properties for a solid body: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-body-properties-source/features/application/body-properties/body-properties.feature:5:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Update unavailable physical properties for a solid body ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open in the MCAD Software with its solid body visible ✔ And no physical-property update has been requested for the body since this document instance was opened ✔ When the user right-clicks the body in the model browser ✔ And the user chooses Properties ✔ Then the Body Properties dialog opens with the body name ✔ And mass, area, volume, and the X, Y, and Z coordinates of the center of gravity show N/A ✔ And the dialog displays a body appearance selector and OK and Cancel buttons ✔ When the user chooses Update ✔ Then mass, area, volume, and the center of gravity coordinates display calculated values ✔ And the solid remains highlighted behind the dialog ✔ When the user chooses Cancel ✔ Then the dialog closes ✔ And the solid remains visible ✔ When the user reopens Body Properties for the same body in the same session ✔ Then the calculated physical properties remain displayed ✔ When the user chooses Cancel ✔ Then the dialog closes
